biography: Riku, known to many as the brother of Panu, made a singular appearance in the Hector Trophée, marking his unique footprint in the history of this esteemed pair competition. His involvement, though brief, adds a distinct chapter to the tournament's narrative.

During his solitary foray onto the Hector Trophée greens, Riku did not manage to secure the coveted Hector Trophée alongside a partner, nor did he claim the individual Victor Trophy. Following this participation, Riku has been broadly regarded as having stepped away from the active competitive circuit, particularly concerning the Hector events.

This current stance is further reflected in his absence from the roster for the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026. While the ebb and flow of competitive golf can always present surprises, Riku's narrative in the Hector Trophée remains one of a distinct, albeit concise, engagement, followed by a quiet withdrawal from its demanding format.
